description: This Java source file defines the class DeleteAttributesStrategy, which handles the DeleteAttributes command in a persistence layer for Thing entities. It applies the command to delete attributes from a Thing and generates corresponding events and results.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesStrategy
classes.description: Immutable class that handles DeleteAttributes commands, updating the attributes of a Thing and generating corresponding results and events.

methods.name: DeleteAttributesStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the DeleteAttributes command type.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Applies the delete attributes command to the given Thing entity within a context, returning a Result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: extractAttributes
methods.description: Extracts the Attributes object from the given Thing, or throws an exception if not present.

methods.name: getDeleteAttributesResult
methods.description: Constructs a Result representing the deletion of attributes, including an AttributesDeleted event.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag of the entity before modification, based on its current attributes.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Indicates the EntityTag after modification, which is not updated in this strategy.
